text: Dear Brian, I follow all this trumpy news because of our fight against putin here in europe and the connection between all this "politics". I'm still in disbelieve about your nowadays Whitehouse! How on earth could this happen? How could a country of 330 million people accept such morons at the top, waging wars (after claiming having ended a bunch, even thinking a peace prize is comming!🤪), announcing tarrifs on the whole world, driving allies away, bullying foreign leaders, comforting dictatorships, breaking the own and international laws, corrupting the whole system, make themselfe rich on the back of the people, comitting high treason by giving enemies a favor ... and on and on ... uncountable crimes all day long? How can generals of the us army accept a man like Hegseth or a guy like Trump at all? I don't get it! And all "brave" people are doing is making a plan for a No Kings ralley in some weeks! That is not enough! That will not stop them at all! They have to much time for more authoritarian steps! Did anyone have studied our 1930th here in germany? Please, do not talk about this traitors 24/7, protest EVERY monday till they are gone! Greetings from Germany, peacefull monday protests had turned our history, brought the east german dictatorship down and prepared for our reunification! That's now more than 35 years ago! It works!
